metadata.description: Short customer identifier, e.g. cust01. Used in all resource names.
Azure region for all resources in this stack.
Resource ID of the shared Log Analytics workspace (from the platform stack).
vNet address space. Intentionally reusable across customers (isolated vNets).
Subnet for session hosts + Kali.
Subnet for the Azure Files private endpoint.
Object ID of the Entra security group containing the consultants for this customer.
Object ID of the Entra security group containing AVD admins (VM admin login).
Enable Entra SSO. true = smooth M365 sign-in but needs a one-time tenant step (enable-avd-sso.ps1); false = zero tenant changes.
Number of personal Windows session hosts (one per consultant).
VM size for Windows session hosts.
VM size for the Kali VM.
Local administrator username for session hosts.
Local administrator password for session hosts.
Admin username for the Kali VM. Azure disallows "admin"/"root"/etc. (gotcha G-012).
Password for the Kali VM admin user (SSH password auth — MVP).
Deploy the Kali VM. Set false for lab / identity-only stacks.
Enrol session hosts in Intune (config-delivery plane, ADR 0008). Needs MDM scope + Intune licensing.
Host pool registration token expiry (ISO 8601). Defaults to deployment time + 24h.
Resource name prefix, e.g. avd-cust01.
Globally-unique storage account name.
Resource ID of the AVD subnet (snet-avd) allowed through the storage firewall via its Microsoft.Storage service endpoint.
Provisioned v2 SSD. PremiumV2_LRS enables the 32 GiB floor + independent IOPS/throughput.
Provisioned size (GiB) for the FSLogix profiles share. v2 minimum is 32.
Registration token expiry timestamp (ISO 8601).
Enable Entra single sign-on. true requires a one-time tenant step (scripts/enable-avd-sso.ps1); false = zero tenant changes but users re-enter their password at the session host / M365 apps.
Enrol session hosts in Intune (MDM auto-enrollment) — config-delivery plane, ADR 0008.
Win11 multi-session-capable Enterprise marketplace image (single-session use).

variables.setupScript:
[format('$ErrorActionPreference="Continue"
$tmp=$env:TEMP
$agent="$tmp\RDAgent.msi"
$boot="$tmp\RDBootLoader.msi"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{0}" -OutFile $agent -UseBasicParsing
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{1}" -OutFile $boot -UseBasicParsing
Start-Process msiexec.exe -Wait -ArgumentList "/i $agent /quiet /norestart REGISTRATIONTOKEN={2}"
Start-Process msiexec.exe -Wait -ArgumentList "/i $boot /quiet /norestart"
try {{ Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://aka.ms/fslogix_download" -OutFile "$tmp\fslogix.zip" -UseBasicParsing; Expand-Archive "$tmp\fslogix.zip" "$tmp\fslogix" -Force; Start-Process (Get-ChildItem "$tmp\fslogix\x64\Release\FSLogixAppsSetup.exe").FullName -Wait -ArgumentList "/install /quiet /norestart" }} catch {{}}
$k="HKLM:\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles"
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name Enabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name VHDLocations -Value "{3}" -PropertyType MultiString -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name VolumeType -Value "VHDX" -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
$o="HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive"
New-Item -Path $o -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $o -Name DisableFileSyncNGSC -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $o -Name DisablePersonalSync -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
$kerb="HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\Kerberos\Parameters"
New-Item -Path $kerb -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $kerb -Name CloudKerberosTicketRetrievalEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
$ts="HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services"
New-Item -Path $ts -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name fEnableScreenCaptureProtect -Value 2 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name fEnableWatermarking -Value 0 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name WatermarkingHeightFactor -Value 180 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name WatermarkingOpacity -Value 2000 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name WatermarkingQrScale -Value 4 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $ts -Name WatermarkingWidthFactor -Value 320 -PropertyType DWORD -Force | Out-Null
', variables('agentUrl'), variables('bootLoaderUrl'), parameters('registrationToken'), variables('profilesUnc'))]

resources.name: [format('{0}/{1}', format('vm-{0}-sh{1}', parameters('prefix'), range(0, parameters('count'))[range(0, parameters('count'))[copyIndex()]]), 'ConfigureSessionHost')]

protectedSettings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -NoProfile -Command "$s=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''{0}'')); $p=Join-Path $env:TEMP ''sh-setup.ps1''; Set-Content -Path $p -Value $s -Encoding UTF8; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -NoProfile -File $p"', base64(variables('setupScript')))]

dependsOn: [resourceId('Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/extensions', format('vm-{0}-sh{1}', parameters('prefix'), range(0, parameters('count'))[range(0, parameters('count'))[range(0, parameters('count'))[copyIndex()]]]), 'AADLoginForWindows')]

metadata.description: Kali admin username. NOTE: Azure disallows "admin"/"root"/etc. (see gotcha G-012).
Password for the Kali admin user (SSH password auth — MVP).
Kali marketplace image. Update sku to a current Kali release (see gotcha G-013).
Auto-shutdown time (24h HHmm) and timezone for cost control.
